item.text:
This pass found an eighth defect in the same untrusted-input family, this time in the snapshot-chunk receiver.

**Finding 8: a forged chunk skips validation and panics on save**

`Chunk.addLocked` ([internal/transport/chunk.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/transport/chunk.go:277)) turns any `save` error into `panicNow`. A peer reaches that path without passing the snapshot validator by setting `HasFileInfo` on the first chunk (validation only applies to `!chunk.HasFileInfo`); with a non-zero `FileChunkId` the chunk is appended to a file that was never created, the save fails, and the error becomes a panic:

```
Chunk.Add panicked on a chunk with an unexpected file chunk id:
    failed to save chunk 0:0:0: open .../snapshot-0000000000000001.gbsnap:
    no such file or directory
--- FAIL: TestAuditChunkWithUnexpectedFileChunkIDDoesNotPanic
```

Rejecting the chunk (log + `return false`) in the fix-verification copy makes both chunk reproductions pass.

**State**

Eight findings, all reproduced on the unmodified tree and all resolved in `audit/diag-fixes/`:

- F1 `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` misses the engine wakeup
- F2 `handleCandidateReadIndex` records a dropped ReadIndex twice
- F3 `pb.Update.HasUpdate` ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`
- F4 `plugin/chan.ChanTransportFactory.Validate` panics
- F5 logger cache ignores the monkey flag
- F6 crafted batch/message frames panic the process (live NodeHost reproduction)
- F7 short first snapshot chunk panics the receiver
- F8 forged `HasFileInfo` chunk panics on save

F6–F8 share a root cause — untrusted peer input is answered with `panic`/`panicNow` instead of an error on the transport receive path — and are grouped as such in the report.

32 audit tests: 22 negative-result/characterisation passes, 10 deliberate reproductions. [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (872 lines) documents all eight; the audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`.
